original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Repacking idle remainders of an unchanged word (covered by the packing ceiling).
Repeating the eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: Complete source-bound COPY62 family: each of nine new 1120-hit patterns from SUPPORT.json may use any joint rank-at-most-six descendant of any rank-seven C/N parent retaining those hits, independently transposed, plus one arbitrary rectangle inside any of the eight coordinate-star squares. Full maximal-slice census reduces to 4096 representative/coordinate cases; 4093 fail diagonal coverage and the remaining three fail a rank-two orthogonal-pair cut.
scope_change_reason: PR1347 excludes mixed copy ranks. Bounded COPY60 searches produced no witness, not an exclusion. The single declared COPY62 pivot produced a new support witness passing all predecessor full-frame and diagonal screens. A broader proper-subframe search did not finish; the delivered negative theorem is explicitly the complete retained-hit quotient of this source-bound witness, not a global COPY62 floor.
bottleneck_link: The COPY62 optimistic profile exceeds the selected-word packing cap by 5.55%, so source-bound coefficient obstructions at this budget close a consequential false-positive path before physical synthesis.
stop_rule: Retain the original search failure as such. Screen mixed COPY62 before searching. Accept only exact support witnesses and explicit rational infeasibility certificates, never floating/native solver UNSAT status alone. State the finite candidate family exactly, without promoting it to an unrestricted decoder lower bound.
evidence: SUPPORT.json; CERTIFICATE.json with full 967232-slice census, all 18 representatives, all three explicit diagonal survivors and rank-two separators; README proof of joint-trim and transpose completeness; additional saturated-frame duality certificate.
author: Adam Gall
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Astra assistance in research, mathematical reasoning, implementation and writing.

optimistic_budget.additional_cost: Optimistically zero for a rejection screen only. Physical copies, frames, restoration, hosting and precision remain unpaid obligations.

open_questions.question: Can different mixed COPY62 supports survive every proper-clique rank cut and saturated-frame duality?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The fully optimistic mixed profile clears the five-percent selected-word ceiling screen.
open_questions.first_step: Change the retained hit patterns and add exact clique and saturated-duality separators to support synthesis before solving for coefficients.
open_questions.blocked_by: The current nine-pattern family is excluded; surviving supports would still need exact coefficients and a fully charged physical realization.
